summary: This sermon launches a series on community and service, teaching from Titus 2 that God's grace adopts believers into a family who are called to live in intentional community with one another and sacrificially serve their neighbors. The pastor emphasizes that Christian maturity is not just knowing information but practicing obedience through relationships and service.
key_points: Adoption: God's grace brings us into his family
Alignment: our identity as God's children motivates obedience to say no to sin and yes to service
Anticipation: waiting for Christ's return shapes how we live now
Community and service are inseparable practices
Practical call to join small groups and serve those in need
big_idea: Jesus welcomed us into his family so we might be sent out to our neighbors
title: Practicing the Way: COMMUNITY
